notes.title: Visual Novel 'What Lydia Knows' Launches FRIDAY May 3rd!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/3a0206c53c19290a6b1538592fe9d1c561111128.png[/img]

Hello Survivors!

Get ready for a double-dose of adventure [b]this Friday, May 3rd[/b], when [i]Outbreak The FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows[/i] launches on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Epic Games Store!

[b]Enjoy a 25% off launch discount here on Steam![/b]

This two game pack includes the following:

[i]FEDORA Files: What Lydia Knows[/i]

In our first file of “[i]The FEDORA Files[/i]” three part limited series: What Lydia Knows, play as intrepid detective Lydia Daniels as she tries to discover the mystery behind her partner's disappearance. Search for clues, probe allies and enemies, and solve the mystery of the Jackson Street Sewers in this installment that acts a prequel to [i]Outbreak: Shades of Horror.[/i]

Features:
[list]
[*]Narrative rich visual novel with a deep and engrossing storyline.
[*]Multiple paths and endings to unlock where your choices matter.
[*]Meet, befriend, or alienate a wide cast of characters where your relationships matter.
[*]Solve devious puzzles and navigate crazy minigames as you hunt for the truth.
[/list]

[i]Outbreak RPG
[/i]
In the aftermath of the Outbreak, play a group of survivors out to rescue their compatriots in Outbreak RPG! A Semi procedurally generated rogue-like RPG, every boot up is a new adventure. Rescued survivors will bring new skills and challenges with them. Can you survive the Outbreak?!

Features:
[list]
[*]Semi procedurally generated rogue-like RPG
[*]Lead your party of four survivors through the apocalypse in turn-based combat
[*]Search for supplies to keep yourself armed and healthy
[*]Rescue a wide group of survivors, each of which joins your team with unique upgrades and abilities
[*]Challenging escalating enemy encounters as the city becomes further overrun with the undead
[*]Hilarious and ridiculous dialogue in this non-canon adventure
[/list]

notes.title: Railbreak VR & Tailbreak BackerKit Finale! Last Chance to Save and Get Goodies! Stream WEDNESDAY and THURSDAY with GIVEAWAYS!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

[url=http://www.railbreakvr.com]Our BackerKit campaign[/url] for [b]Railbreak VR & Tailbreak[/b] is coming to an end at 11:59pm ET on February 29!  That means time is running out for us to meet additional stretch goals and for you to get all kinds of goodies!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/c1413f9b5e95cea0732ecb9c0a099206fd0b75c7.jpg[/img]

If we make it to [b]$12,500[/b] in total raised funds, we'll be adding an in-game developer commentary track DLC in additional to an extra story chapter for the [b]Tailbreak[/b] DLC expansion!  Then, at [b]$15,000[/b], we will be able to release [b]Railbreak VR[/b] & the [b]Tailbreak[/b] DLC for [b]Meta Quest 3[/b]!

If you choose to support [b]Railbreak VR & Tailbreak[/b] on BackerKit, you'll be able to preorder exactly what you want with an early bird discount!  That means you can get [b]Railbreak VR & Tailbreak[/b] for below their final MSRP!

But that's not all!

As you may or may not know, there are a variety of tiers and add-ons available [url=http://www.railbreakvr.com]on our BackerKit campaign[/url].  Below are a few of the tiers that we think are super cool!

[b]The Big T-Rex Collection ($65 USD)[/b]

[i]Receive digital game codes for Railbreak VR and Tailbreak at launch including access to special game content DLC. This tier also includes a copy of the original non-VR Railbreak, Dinobreak, and the Railbreak Special Kickstarter demo that was private to backers of the Outbreak: Shades of Horror Kickstarter on your supported platform of choice. All non-Railbreak VR and Tailbreak digital codes will be delivered by end of April 2024. This collection is offered at a discount compared to the launch MSRP of all of these items.[/i]

[b]Maximum Carnage Franchise Bundle - Includes 7 Physical Games + Trading Cards! ($179 USD)[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/e5abbebabced8e0990998a47a8da870180a0458f.png[/img]

[i]This tier includes the following ALL SIGNED by the developers:
- Gold Limited Run Trading Card from the Outbreak series
- Silver Limited Run Trading Card from the Outbreak series
- Outbreak: Contagious Memories - PS5
- Outbreak: Contagious Memories - PS4
- Outbreak: Contagious Memories - Switch - Limited Run Games Cover Variant 
- Outbreak: Contagious Memories - Switch - Amazon Cover Variant 
- Outbreak Collection Part 1 - Switch - Limited Run Games Cover Variant 
- Outbreak Collection Part 1 - Switch - Amazon Cover Variant 
- Outbreak Collection Part 2

(This tier also includes EVERYTHING from [b]The Big T-Rex Collection[/b])

Shipping is $10 in the United States. $15 outside of the United States. Physical titles will ship to you in April 2024. Trading cards may have different artwork than what is pictured.

Arcade Legend - Includes Signed Sinden Lightgun w/ Rumble + 7 Physical Games & more! ($399 USD, only ONE left as of this post!)[/i]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/15dc0faca2bf2c927a8b44171c150a223cfa8655.png[/img]

[i]This title includes everything in the [b]Maximum Carnage Franchise Bundle[/b] and:

An exclusive Sinden Lightgun with Rumble signed by the developers so you can take on Railbreak and Tailbreak in arcade style! The lightgun color will be random and may be different than the image.

You'll never find a better deal than this, and it's just for the BackerKit campaign!

Shipping is $20 in the United States, $35 outside of the United States. Lightgun and physical games ship in April 2024. Some digital games ship in April 2024, see the earlier tiers for details.[/i]

We will be streaming [url=http://www.twitch.tv/deaddropstudios]on our Twitch channel[/url] this [b]Wednesday AND Thursday night at 7:15pm ET[/b] to finish out the campaign! You can expect [b]multiple giveaways[/b] on both streams!  We'll be going through Claire A in the N64 version of Resident Evil 2, and we'll even make our way toward the Dreamcast version of Dino Crisis!  If you don't follow us on Twitch already, [url=http://www.twitch.tv/deaddropstudios]make sure to follow us there[/url] so you can see when you go live!

That's all for today, Survivors!  Thank you for support!  Let's finish out this campaign with a BANG so we can make Railbreak VR & the Tailbreak DLC expansion the best they can possibly be!

notes.title: Railbreak VR & Tailbreak Campaign + Railbreak Free CU1 Arrives Jan 30th @ 1PM ET!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/18eab947c1904877d9aead0e2b310f8b3fd4e73e.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors!

Wow, we have a lot to talk about and a busy week ahead! Let's get to it!

[h1]Railbreak VR & Tailbreak Crowdfunding Campaign is LIVE on Jan 30th @ 1PM ET![/h1]

Everyone has been asking for it, so we're doing it! Back our BackerKit Crowdfunding Campaign on Jan 30th @ 1PM ET to help make Railbreak VR on SteamVR and Tailbreak for both Railbreak and Railbreak VR happen!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/b24ad3702e11a74d9677cb65b8f51cc753685ead.jpg[/img]

Railbreak VR is exactly what it sounds like - a full native standalone implementation of SteamVR for all of Railbreak (and Tailbreak!). Experience the sights and sounds through your cutting edge VR headset as you take on the waves of glitched infected and dinos in the over-the-top insanity of the world of Railbreak!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/09dcd01d9751e8d0756c65a8b83a7e15bd694a88.jpg[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/57154e17d646979356cbd5ad8e2b5855f1cf3beb.jpg[/img]

And we're going to have some absolutely INSANE giveaways! So go follow our Backerkit Crowdfunding page right now at http://www.railbreakvr.com so you don't miss your chance to back the project, and get in on these amazing giveaways!

We'll also be streaming all day starting at 1PM ET on twitch.tv/deaddropstudios !

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/5ae8d6136ea319bd52238060bed0d70b3c83d2f3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Railbreak Content Update One - Time Korrisis - Arrives on Jan 30th, 2024![/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qr1tBwmlCBQ&lc=UgxBbOrsZtbDsZ1JnAR4AaABAg

Our first content update is coming to Railbreak on all platforms on Jan 30th! Featuring the brand new Time Korrisis mode that is playable in every part of Railbreak, you'll be racing the clock as you fight through the undead to score more time and survive the nightmare! You can play this mode across all of Railbreak, so think of it as a new game plus!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/fd94ba5c418a7c0e038ef34b4c81fde4fbf32439.jpg[/img]

[i](Apologies for the double post, but we put the wrong month in the original update and apparently we can't edit it. The correct date is January 30th, 2024 for everything!)[/i]

We also have our new character, Korrine the Glitch Goddess, joining the cast! She's our first expert level character and she's challenging but incredibly fun to use. She uses all new projectile weapons (instead of the hitscan of other characters) and boasts the beastly Plasma Cannon, Glitched Sidearm, and the Katana which has the ability to trigger super glitches! Get ready for a brand new experience!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/c2c396ccff24672041b4886222f57c1db4bb8355.jpg[/img]

We'll be back on Tuesday with more news, but get ready for some crazy antics and follow the BackerKit Crowdfunding campaign now at http://www.railbreakvr.com so you're ready! (AND TELL YOUR FRIENDS!)

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/6e8a7fb8f42a7919bc10bc823a4763f845edb2d4.jpg[/img]

See you on Tuesday!

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 3 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/84af881a4de8ca531fad3bc7918e0214d96de8c4.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

[h1]Patch 3[/h1]
- Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1ad558ba52773cb53b86bf159aa488a7e6dce9af.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors!

Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!

Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!

[h1]Patch 2[/h1]
- Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
- Added the Update Notes screen.
- High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
- Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
- Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
- Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
- Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
- Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
- Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

notes.title: Railbreak is available NOW! Launch stream NOW with giveaways!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

https://youtu.be/y-WS-KRfjDM

Today's the day!  [b]Railbreak[/b] is now available on [b][url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/railbreak/9N25GV4TVG0C]Xbox Series X|S[/url][/b], [b]PlayStation 5[/b], and on PC via [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587170/Railbreak/]Steam[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/railbreak-f87a0c]Epic Games Store[/url][/b]!  Pick it up for [b]$19.99 USD[/b] worldwide (international pricing may vary).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587170/Railbreak/

While Cypress Ridge is enduring a zombie apocalypse in [b]Outbreak: Shades of Horror[/b], Lydia and Hank hit the arcade for some stress relief!  [b]Railbreak[/b] is packed with features and content that will keep you playing! It's a beefy on-rails arcade shooter for the modern age, and it's built in [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b]!

Players can look forward to:
[list]
[*]A fully voiced, cheese-tastic [b]Story[/b]!
[*][b]Score Attack[/b] for grinding those high scores!
[*]The endless [b]Onslaught[/b] mode that'll test your skills!
[*][b]'Glitch'[/b] modifiers that keep the gameplay fast and feisty!
[*][b]Eight total unlockable characters[/b], each with their own loadouts and stats!
[*][b]Seven radical bosses[/b] that are out for blood!
[*]A special scenario that celebrates our supporters -- [b]Shoutout Shootout[/b]!
[*][b]Glitch Gauntlet[/b], A rogue-like version of the campaign with randomized 'Glitches' and enemies!
[*]The mother of all challenges in [b]Boss Rush[/b]!
[*][b]Full game, optional co-op support[/b] so you can spread the lead with a friend!
[*]Optional support for [b]Sinden Lightguns[/b] on PC platforms!
[*][b]Local score tracking[/b], a comprehensive [b]How to Play manual[/b], and tons of [b]settings and options[/b]!
[/list]

[b]Please note: If you are playing on Xbox Series X|S, there is a 'day one' update that is not yet live. This will be available as soon as possible. Thank you for your understanding, and sorry for the inconvenience![/b]

We've also prepared a series of guides for those of you who are purchasing the [b]Steam[/b] version of the game in order to best enjoy it in a variety of configurations:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2587170/discussions/0/4031348734037664585/]Railbreak Sinden Lightgun Guide[/url] - Setup instructions for using a [b]Sinden Lightgun[/b] with [b]Railbreak[/b]!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2587170/discussions/0/4042608198321108088/]Recommended Steam Deck Settings[/url] - How to best configure [b]Railbreak[/b] for use on Steam Deck!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2587170/discussions/0/4042608198331785572/]Controls and Remote Play Together Guide[/url] - See default controls and other tips for multiplayer!

If you aren't already a part of [url=https://discord.gg/deaddropstudios]our Discord community[/url], join today and share your best scores with us!  We're holding a [b]launch contest through January 5th at 11:59pm ET[/b] with a special prize, so come and compete with the best for your chance to win!

Meanwhile, [b]tonight, December 22nd, at 7PM ET (that's right now!)[/b], we're having a special launch stream on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/deaddropstudios]our Twitch channel[/url]!  For the first time, we'll also be streaming live to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587170/Railbreak/]Railbreak's Steam store page[/url]!  Join us for [b]Railbreak[/b] gameplay featuring the [b]Sinden Lightgun[/b], retro on-rail shooter game goodness, and [b]giveaways[/b]

Our games are also on sale as part of [b]Steam's Winter Sale[/b], and that includes the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20872/Outbreak_Complete_Collection/]Outbreak Complete Collection[/url], which also includes Railbreak! Save on a ton of great Dead Drop Studios games today with this special bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20872/Outbreak_Complete_Collection

With that, we're entering a Holiday break period.  On behalf of everyone at [b]Dead Drop Studios[/b], we would like to wish you and your families a very Merry Christmas, an incredibly Happy Holiday, and a fantastic New Year!

See you in 2024, Survivors!

notes.title: DINOBREAK Patch Available! "Making Friends" Achievement Fix & More!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/52b1141709bcc09776b0835c6a47d1499963ce40.png[/img]

Hello Survivors!

First off, thank you to everyone who has supported DINOBREAK so far!

We've pushed out a patch that fixes and tweaks a few things:

[list]
[*] "Making Friends" achievement now properly functions!
[*] Improvements made to cutscene speech volume.
[*] Eggs hatch less frequently.
[*] Weapon, item, and environment balancing across the game has been tweaked to reduce difficulty.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

If you've played the game and enjoyed it, please leave us a positive review!  It really helps us out a lot! If you haven't picked up DINOBREAK yet, there's still time to enjoy the 20% launch discount-- it runs until October 10th!

We're always listening to your feedback, so please keep it coming!

Thanks as always, Survivors!

notes.title: Outbreak: Endless Nightmares Releases on May 19th, 2021!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33023292/6c107c67eb2e503bc66f58e9512599686b2c8fb8.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419350/Outbreak_Endless_Nightmares/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HOKiSeM7hm8
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-GameDescription-600.jpg?t=1618691544[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-steamgif-OTS-02.gif?t=1618691544[/img]
Outbreak: Endless Nightmares twists the series' survival horror gameplay by adding elements of roguelike gameplay. You'll need to explore, hunt for supplies, uncover clues, and fight your way through each anomaly – each consisting of semi-procedurally generated instances where both the environment, and the undead, are out to kill you!

Immediately after the events of Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles, you find yourself trapped within the remains of Arzt Memorial Hospital – the hub to organize your inventory and storage cache, level up your character, or just to take a breather before venturing back out into the chaos. There’s more to discover in the world besides murderous hordes of the undead – find the journals scattered about to learn more about the outbreak and ultimately where to find refuge! Don’t think death can save you – every time you die, you'll awake trapped in this nexus.

Outbreak: Endless Nightmares focuses on extreme replayability by offering multiple character options – each with their own abilities, upgrade paths and more! Each time you venture into the anomaly, it’ll change and become increasingly difficult as you grow in power. You'll need to think carefully about what weapons, healing items, and other supplies you'll bring along. If you're lucky, you may find storage caches that give you access to your expanded inventory, and offer an opportunity to restock. But it's all on you to search your environment for supplies. If you run out ... your fate is sealed!
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-KeyFeatures-600.jpg?t=1618691544[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-steamgif-tactical-01.gif?t=1618691544[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Something Old, Something New:[/b] Outbreak’s signature classic survival gameplay mixed with roguelike elements.
[*][b]An Expanding World:[/b] Explore a massive, semi-procedurally generated world that expands as the game progresses! Talk to NPCs, visit shops, etc.
[*][b]Three Camera Angles:[/b] Choose a view that works for you – Fixed camera, over the shoulder, or first person. 
[*][b]Photo Mode:[/b] Take beautiful pictures with the camera or use the photo mode to scan or anything dangerous nearby!
[*][b]Death Isn’t the End:[/b] Death returns you to the hub with most of your inventory intact, experience, and money.
[*][b]Semi-Procedurally Generated Dungeons:[/b] Revisit anomaly dungeons multiple times to find different traps, enemies, puzzles, challenges – and loot! 
[*][b]Co-Op:[/b] Fight the nightmare with a friend in 2-player Split-Screen Co-Op.
[*][b]Character Options:[/b] Choose from 6 unique characters, each with their own backstory, stats, and ability loadouts.
[*][b]Crafting:[/b] Dismantle, repair, and upgrade weapons; build ammo through gunpowder; and combine healing items to create new formulas and more!
[*][b]Game Modes:[/b] Choose from 5 gameplay modes – Standard, Ironman, Randomizer, Lost Hope, and Easy Mode.
[*][b]Uncover the Story: [/b]Search through notes and logs to read more from Lydia’s journal and piece together the past and future of the outbreak.
[*][b]Late Game Content / New Game+:[/b] Face a randomly generated dungeon of extreme danger near the end of the game AND try multiple new game + modes after completing the story.
[/list]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-steamgif-fixed-03.gif?t=1618691544[/img]

notes.title: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles Chapter Two - Releasing June 18th, 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/ef7d3f1add75493e9023c4a4b4d1591c7640b6ff.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/828630/Outbreak_The_Nightmare_Chronicles__Chapter_2/]Return to the world of survival horror on the evening of June 18th, 2018.[/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/74b79c4e75f155be7054ddb3a26abf983e629f94.jpg[/img]
[h1]Chapter Two[/h1]
Lydia's fight for survival continues as she explores the tunnels underneath the manor. When you last left her, she had barely survived her encounter with a brute, was out of ammo and was desperate for safety. Your adventure picks up in the tunnels beneath as she faces new challenges, including pitch darkness. Featuring new Story Mode and Battle Mode chapters taking place in the tunnels. Can you survive the nightmare?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/1aa34973ba50c3202190a52d41230a2536fe9422.jpg[/img]
[h1]Patch v1.2[/h1]
When Chapter Two releases, the next patch will be included. This patch includes enemy combat adjustments that give you more of a chance to dodge incoming attacks. It also includes graphics upgrades like volumetric lighting for Lydia's flashlights. There is also some minor difficulty and content adjustments and general bugfixes.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/c564e09331428c8b3b396cf7291eed1b315b0fb1.jpg[/img]
[h1]What do I need to buy to play?[/h1]
You have several options. If you purchase The Complete Edition, you will have access to this content on the release date. If you own the base game, you can buy the Season Pass or purchase Chapter Two separately via Steam.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/52ccad51b1dcbb9455d4d9fe4d94979a69d8deec.jpg[/img]
Thank you for continuing to support the Outbreak series! Get ready to survive this pitch black nightmare soon and tell your friends!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 5/20/2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/c564e09331428c8b3b396cf7291eed1b315b0fb1.jpg[/img]
I never said which week...

[h1]Chapter Two Progress Update[/h1]
The layout for the Chapter Two map is virtually complete, but there's no actual game logic or events in yet. Get ready for a descent into darkness though as Lydia tries to escape the underground, while battling out-of-control gas mains spewing fire. The darkness is going to provide cover for the undead as well... and they can come from anywhere. In the coming weeks, I'll be working to add notes, interests and all of the other gameplay events that make an Outbreak scenario fun.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/65abd1bd1c6c3f1024c6ca935a3360491f744335.jpg[/img]
[h1]Combat Fixes[/h1]
Chapter Two will also debut with some improvements to how enemies attack you. Right now, it's very difficult to juke an enemy and run past them without taking damage. There will be improvements that will allow enemies to only hit you when they're at a certain point in their animation swing. This has been one of the most requested features and it should greatly improve gameplay.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/dfd2d91bdbb0e06af90bd0f8feda834f69e18150.jpg[/img]
[h1]So when will it be out?[/h1]
I'm still not ready to commit to a release date, but the goal is for Chapter Two to debut during summer. There's still a lot more that needs to go into it before it's ready. As always, it'll likely appear on Steam before Xbox One.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/52ccad51b1dcbb9455d4d9fe4d94979a69d8deec.jpg[/img]
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
As always, thank you to the entire community for playing ALL of the Outbreak games! It's been great to see more and more folks trying the games and the good reviews pouring in. Keep sharing them with your friends and your support is super appreciated and critical to the franchise continuing. Thank you!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/1aa34973ba50c3202190a52d41230a2536fe9422.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: There will be improvements that will allow enemies to only hit you when they're at a certain point in their animation swing. This has been one of the most requested features and it should greatly improve gameplay.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - 5/5/2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/315f6f2d6fc450471251924e891df84e9cb34883.jpg[/img]
The irony of calling these updates "Weekly" is not lost on me...

[h1]You never write... You never call...[/h1]
It has been an absolute whirlwind the last two months. Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles has now launched on both Steam and Xbox One (to pretty good reviews I'd say!). As such, a lot of my time has been spent preparing for those releases, working through cert and handling all of the "non-dev" parts of being an indie developer. I pushed a PC-side Steam patch a few weeks back and all of those fixes made it into the Xbox One version that was released a few days back. But with those releases behind me... it's time to think about the future...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/10b5e0e4a86b300841730a4ef4c719fda5dc0e30.jpg[/img]
[h1]Chapter Two[/h1]
Chapter One saw Lydia's story continue as she survived the events of The New Nightmare and now found herself alone in a manor. Well, spoiler alert, but she survived Chapter One as well. Chapter Two picks up almost immediately after the end of the first chapter, with her exploring even further beneath the manor. She's going to find all new horrors down there and gameplay is taking a bit of a shift... There will be some new locations, but I don't want to spoil them too much in the screenshots here.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/06e90dc82a5af6088266babd76cb3e4bac26e174.jpg[/img]
[h1]Being Alone in the Dark...[/h1]
The theme of Chapter Two is going to be darkness. Let's just say near the start of Chapter Two, there's going to be a bit of a power loss in the underground section. As such, Lydia will need to rely on her trusty flashlight to find a way back to the surface alive. Anywhere she isn't looking, will be pitch black. Think of this as a loving homage to Silent Hill...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/0cf20bf0348781015224788caab26cb4a918d265.jpg[/img]
[h1]Graphics Improvements[/h1]
With darkness being so prominent in Chapter Two, it made sense to make some lighting upgrades. Lydia's flashlight and chest light will now have volumetric light beams. This greatly helps in illuminating the darkness, but you'll also notice them subtly added to Chapter One. They're far more prominent in pitch black. You'll face this darkness in the next set of Battle Mode rooms as well...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/fb310eadb8751df1e1aedc257e52c6be713dc381.jpg[/img]
[h1]So when is Chapter Two coming out?[/h1]
It's going to be a while. I'm a solo dev working on the game in my limited free time. I'll try to keep sharing updates and I hope it won't be too long, but let's say we'll aim for sometime during the summer if things go well. I would imagine the Xbox release will trail Steam in general for The Nightmare Chronicles as I can release faster on Steam. Stay tuned for more details.

[b]Thank you to everyone who has purchased and played any games in the Outbreak series! It has been an awesome ride and the feedback and support is amazing. It's awesome to have such a great community and COME JOIN US ON DISCORD![/b]

tags.feature: Lydia's flashlight and chest light will now have volumetric light beams.

We're happy to announce that v1.1 of Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles has been released for Windows, Mac and Linux. Changes include:
[list]
    [*]Greatly reduced the "frozen indicator" loading period while loading a new section. This means that the initial load of your new or saved game and subsequent sections should be faster while you play. (Note: This was not reported in the in-game notes but was included in this release).
    [*]Fixed an issue where the player could pass through a specific wall.
    [*]Reduced the amount of available ammo across the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles Announced!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/69579e0d1cb78788079b9c9a4066ba515d55f91f.png[/img]
[b]Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles, featuring single-player adventures in the Outbreak universe, has been announced![/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/09726cd0617b24b17163a42b354885790748cca1.jpg[/img]
[h1]What is Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles?[/h1]
Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles is a slower-paced single-player survival horror adventure. Whereas Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare focused on high intensity co-op play, The Nightmare Chronicles instead focuses on a slower-paced, highly difficult survival horror experience. Taking place chronologically right after The New Nightmare concluded, The Nightmare Chronicles will follow the cast of survivors as they attempt to survive after being split up.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/4ca80edb55a4b37f7cf428c7ac25cecaf42508d2.jpg[/img]
[h1]How will the game be structured?[/h1]
The game will feature episodic-style play focusing on a specific character. The initial chapter, which features Lydia, will take her through an abandoned manor that she sought safety in after being split up from the group. This initial chapter will be a low-priced offering and subsequent chapters will be offered as paid DLC when they are available. This allows players to only pay for content they want while ensuring the game can be delivered faster in piecemeal form.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/64998c0e1d98df06d45d147a76f175251a09e2fc.jpg[/img]
[h1]How is this game different than Outbreak and Outbreak: The New Nightmare?[/h1]
Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles will focus on exploration and strict inventory management to survive. You will need to thoroughly search your environment to find supplies, solve puzzles and stand a chance against threats. The Nightmare Chronicles also forgoes the full, open maps from the previous games and instead features instanced rooms like in classic survival horror. This allows you to potentially flee a room to escape from a foe and face them later. The Nightmare Chronicles will feature linked storage caches for managing your items and require you to find consumable floppy disks to save your game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/67f92ce258ecdc5427641b7e242d4dba95dbf093.jpg[/img]
[h1]What else has changed?[/h1]
With the gameplay getting mixed up, you'll also find some improvements under the hood. Game performance in The Nightmare Chronicles will be significantly better than in The New Nightmare due to the ability to instance geometry and game logic in individual rooms or location. As such, the recommended and minimum system requirements have dropped significantly.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285349/897ba0ba7588c5da84b2bfa2ff6dfc43a26bd708.jpg[/img]
[h1]When will we get to play the first chapter?[/h1]
There is no announced release date for the first chapter, which likely will be 1-2 hours of gameplay, just yet. Since this game is developed by a solo dev without a budget, these things take time to build and polish. We'll be in touch later on with more information.
